name: Cinematic Portrait

input.setting: standing by a large window at golden hour

example.output: masterpiece, best quality, high quality, high resolution, highly detailed, sharp focus, crisp, 85mm portrait lens, close-up portrait, petzval portrait lens, swirling bokeh, depth of field, cinematic lighting, rim lighting, moody lighting, soft diffused lighting, cinematic portrait, film grain, Kodak Portra 400, elegant pose, subtle emotion, young woman with flowing dark hair standing by a large window at golden hour, serene and contemplative expression, golden hour window light creates warm cinematic glow, deep bokeh background, --v 6 --ar 2:3 --style raw
